Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing certain PUDs to operate an electrical appliance repair service.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to maintenance and repair of electrical appliancesby a public utility district that provides electrical service; andadding a new section to chapter 54.16 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 54.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A public utility district located within a county that has acontiguous border with the state of Oregon and a population of threehundred forty thousand or more that provides electrical, water, andsewer service to its customers may operate an electrical appliancerepair service.
